name: BucklerFamily.Estate handbook
status: published; items marked PENDING BUILD or PROPOSED are not yet live
purpose: Maintenance and upkeep guide for BucklerFamily.Estate (the Cedwyn site) as one giant snowballing flywheel: LLM wiki and evidence catalogue, one central chronological record of the Cedwyn estate, its former manorial house and the Williams families, and ongoing public-interest research.

apex_flywheel.name: Cedwyn Snowball

arcs.name: ask
arcs.what: research questions and records requests go out (FOI/EIR/SAR drafts, archive, book and web searches)

arcs.name: receive
arcs.what: replies, disclosures and primary material arrive; silences recorded

arcs.name: clarify
arcs.what: new questions asked, clarification sought, contrary reading tested

arcs.name: organise and officiate
arcs.what: one canonical catalogue entry with label, parcel and date; task register and central artifact database updated; findings made official records

arcs.name: reconstruct
arcs.what: the story, estate, family, public history and heritage rebuilt into one central chronological, accurate record

arcs.name: present
arcs.what: the record feeds the Argentina museum, the Wales guided tour, the online dimension (maps, games, webapps), documentary scenes made in real time, and e-books

arcs.name: re-release
arcs.what: every output re-released under a new semantic version as information quality improves

arcs.name: learn and return
arcs.what: replies, readers and agents raise the next questions; lessons to the Agent Library; back to A1

apex_flywheel.axle: upkeep: build, Cloudflare, GitHub, HubSpot hygiene, Hive, version standard, problems queue, Agent Library
apex_flywheel.measure: S(n+1) = S(n) + V + R + G + A + P + B - D - U - W

outputs: museum in Argentina (Great House Farm II concept)
online dimension: maps, games, webapps (59 planned slots)
documentary scenes made in real time
research reports in the public interest
